card.name: "On" after sentence-opening "Based"
card.fires_on: The word "on" right after a capitalized "Based" that starts a sentence or follows a section heading. It is most common in warnings sections, such as Embryo-Fetal Toxicity, where the sentence goes on to cite animal data or study findings.

modes.label: After warning headings
modes.description: "Based on" starts the text right after a numbered heading such as Embryo-Fetal Toxicity.

modes.label: Sentence-initial in text
modes.description: "Based on" opens a sentence that cites data or results.
modes.example: In vitro, dolutegravir did not induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, CYP3A4. Based<< on>> these data and the results of drug interaction
